the use of self-mention and self-citation is an important rhetorical strategy for academics in the construction of their knowledge claims, research credentials, and professional standing.

self-mention is an important rhetorical strategy that is used in the service of knowledge construction, and that its use varies according to the epistemic norms of the discipline and the rhetorical goals of the author.

The main takeaway from our work is that

self-mention and self-citation are not simply a matter of individual self-aggrandizement, but a complex set of rhetorical strategies used by academics in the pursuit of their research goals and disciplinary identities.
self-citation and self-mention should not be treated as a simple indicator of egotism but as a complex rhetorical device with a range of uses and meanings.
